items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I know my uncle Johnny Sing said he was playing with some band up there

ctx.x: See, I was wondering how, what the difference would be in the music you'd hear on Perdido Street in that neighborhood when you were living there? And up in Carlton? It's all the same. All the same, huh? Yeah, all the same. And what would you hear up in Carlton? Do you remember any of that?

He asked me, me and Ragtime, he was the Carlton in them days. And who would be playing at the bar? Well, I don't know. I know my uncle Johnny Sing said he was playing with some band up there, but I can't recall who it was, because I never heard him mention his name.
And how many guys in the band? Do you remember the band that band? It was four then, at that time, I remember. What was your uncle playing?
